record.reason: Llamion converts Orion-14B into a standardized Llama-family architecture via parameter mapping and distillation. The paper says deployment-friendly architectures can be adopted without pretraining, but does not demonstrate inference latency, throughput, or memory improvements; relevance to inference systems remains weak.
